app.title: PayHop: payment QR codes and split bills in your browser
app.desc: Make a payment QR code and split a bill on your device. PayHop shows who gets paid and never touches the money.
ft.tagline: Payment QR codes and split bills, made in your browser.
hero.h1: Payment QR codes, made on your device
hero.lede: Type who gets paid and how much. PayHop builds the QR in your browser, shows the name it will pay, and never touches the money. Split a bill and send everyone their share.
hero.proof: No account needed. Nothing you type is uploaded.
home.s1_sub: A wrong payment QR is hard to undo. Every screen puts the receiver's name first.
home.b1_p: Links and bank transfers whose structure is public. Bank-QR schemes such as QRIS and Pix come after we test them on real QR codes.
home.b2_p: Before you can download, you confirm the receiver. Hidden and right-to-left characters in names are stripped, and the name is printed under the QR.
home.b3_p: Amounts are whole minor units, never floats. The odd unit is shared out, and the person who paid absorbs any rounding.
home.b4_p: The QR is drawn on your device and works offline once the page has loaded. Guests leave nothing on our server.
home.b5_p: PayHop does not process money. Saved payment methods need a HOP ID, are encrypted at rest and can be deleted at any time.
home.b6_p: Each format says whether it has been tried in a real wallet. Until then it says so on the screen, not in a footnote.
home.holds_paypal: A paypal.me link with amount and currency
home.holds_cashapp: A cash.app link with the amount
home.holds_venmo: A venmo.com link with amount and note
home.holds_solana: A solana: address with amount and token
home.holds_upi: A upi://pay request with name and amount
home.holds_epc: A SEPA credit transfer (BCD) with IBAN check
home.later: Waiting for real sample QR codes:
home.s3_sub: One HOP ID signs you in everywhere.

split.sub: Add who was there, what each item cost and who shared it. Taxes and tips are spread by what each person ordered.
split.round_hint: Everyone except the person who paid is rounded up; the payer takes the difference, so the total never changes.
split.method_hint: Fill in how {payer} wants to be paid. Each person's QR holds their own share.

terms.p1: PayHop makes payment QR codes and splits bills in your browser. It does not process, hold or move money, and it is not a bank or a payment service.
terms.p2: You are responsible for the name, account and amount you type. Check the receiver name before you pay or share a code. Every format is marked as not tested in a wallet yet: scan with a small amount first.
terms.p3: PayHop is provided as is, without warranty. We are not liable for payments made with a code that you or someone else created.
terms.p4: Do not use PayHop to deceive people or to imitate someone else's name or account. Misuse can be reported to the HOP security contact, and sign-in can be suspended.
priv.p1: As a guest, what you type stays in your browser tab. Nothing is sent to our server, and the generator and the split calculator work offline once the page has loaded.
priv.p2: If you sign in with a HOP ID, we keep your account id, name, email and a session cookie so you stay signed in. Payment details and bills are stored only if you choose to save them (see below).
priv.p3: We set no tracking or advertising cookies. Your browser keeps only your theme, language and interface style, and the sign-in cookie when you sign in.
priv.p4: To ask about or delete your data, use the contact page on hel.ink, or delete your HOP ID there.
priv.p5: Saved payment methods (up to 20) and bills (the last 200) exist only for signed-in accounts, one item at a time and only after you tick the consent box. They are encrypted on our server with AES-256-GCM, never written to logs, never shown to other HOP apps or the control center, and removed when you delete them or delete your HOP ID. PayHop never stores card numbers, and guests never write anything to the server.
terms.p5: Saving a payment method or a bill is your choice for each item. You are responsible for what you save and may delete it at any time. If saving is switched off on the server, everything else keeps working.
